reviews.author: Katrina
reviews.text: This was our second year staying at this cottage and we plan to continue visiting it for many years to come! It is a lovely retreat for us as a couple with our two dogs. It was a joy for us to see our dogs playing in the yard, in the sand, and splashing in the water. We spent lots of time outside by the water and really enjoyed the addition of the hammock this year. The fire pit is also beautifully situated with a sunset view of the lake. The inside of the cabin is stunning and extremely clean. The owner is super friendly and communicated everything we needed to know. During our down time, we took many trips to town, including the Bobcaygeon Locks, Bobcaygeon Wildlife Park, and of course, Fenelon Falls. Highly recommend staying here! Thank you for the wonderful hospitality!

reviews.author: Keith
reviews.text: We spent a few nights here during the kids' holiday break, and it was the perfect winter getaway. Being less than two hours from the city made the travel stress-free. The backyard has a perfect little hill where our kids spent hours tobogganing and playing with the snow and ice. The frozen lake was spectacular; walking across the ice at sunrise and sunset provided some of the most beautiful views we've ever seen.After our outdoor adventures, the indoor fireplace was a dream, warming us up instantly and creating such a cozy atmosphere. We also loved being just 10 minutes from Bobcaygeon town. The girls had a blast at the community outdoor rink and the nearby playground. This cottage is a gem for families looking to unplug and enjoy a classic Canadian winter!

reviews.author: Yin
reviews.text: We recently had the pleasure of staying at this wonderful cottage in the summer, and it truly gave my family a memorable getaway. Honestly, the photos don't do it justice—the view of the lake is absolutely incredible and breathtaking from morning to evening.It was the perfect spot for our children (ages 6 and 8). They spent hours kayaking, swimming in the clear lake, and playing in the sandpit. A huge plus for us was the cottage's design; the abundance of windows in the main living area made it incredibly easy to keep a watchful eye on them while they played outside.The owners have clearly put a lot of care into this space. It was spotlessly clean upon arrival, and the well-maintained green space outside made enjoying the beautiful views even easier. Their attention to detail ensures a comfortable and relaxing stay for guests.For a change of scenery, we drove into Bobcaygeon, which is a nice little town with a great variety of dinner options. We really enjoyed exploring it.We can't wait to return and highly recommend this cottage to any family looking for a perfect lakeside vacation!

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.text:
Fantastic experience at Kim's cottage! Beautiful location, very swimmable. Fully equipped with everything we needed. Kim was responsive, on top of things and very proactive with her communication. Friendly neighbours.
The cottage is only a 10 min drive to Bobcaygeon, which is a huge bonus.
We are already hoping we can book again next year and make it an annual rental.

reviews.author: David
reviews.text: Absolutely Stunning property, clean home, very spacious, peaceful area, above all Kim is a Super host, all the very best to her 😊 we love to be back here before summer ends 😇

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.text: Had a great time at Kim’s place. The views are stunning, and the house is beautiful, clean, and has lots to do. Good for all kinds of groups. Kim and Sherman were very responsive with the very few questions or concerns we had throughout the stay. Would highly recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.text: Easy access to the lake and great view to chill

reviews.author: Patti
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at Kim’s cottage on Pigeon Lake!  The cottage itself is beautiful and very clean!  Bathrooms were pristine!! The large windows offered scenic views of the lake.  Bedrooms are spacious and have comfortable beds.  There is a wonderful antique buffet unit, setup as a coffee/tea station in the breakfast nook, and we made our coffee every morning and enjoyed it on their great dock.   The dock is great and we tied our boat to it.  We would highly recommend this cottage to anyone looking to enjoy a getaway with some beautiful views, fishing, swimming  and close to some cute towns to explore.

reviews.author: murray p.
reviews.text: This vacation rental certainly checked all of the boxes for our multi-generational family group.  Accommodations were excellent and the hosts provided lots of games, indoor and outdoor toys, books and puzzles so all ages were kept active, regardless of the weather.  Highly recommend this rental for a family vacation or a group of friends.

reviews.author: Karen T.
reviews.text: Stayed with the family for 4 nights at this beautiful and very clean lakefront cottage.  There were many updates (kitchen, bathrooms, etc.), while still maintaining a lovely cottage-y vibe.  Close to the boat launch.  Kim is a great host - very communicative and detailed.

reviews.author: Michael R.
reviews.text: A great combination of a very friendly and communicative host, and a wonderful cottage and location. The lake views, and the soaring ceilings of the great room were spectacular. The beautiful cottage has all you need to enjoy and is very roomy, the location comes with lots of privacy and quiet. That panoramic lake view is really something to see. I cant wait to get back here again, thanks so much for everything Kim.

reviews.author: Wendy N.
reviews.text: Everything was just like it was in the description and photos.  The home was very clean and the host was very easy to contact.  My family stayed here for one week and we all enjoyed our time and the grandkids loved the lake toys and games that were available.  It has a beautiful view and right  on Pigeon lake.  Having the full kitchen with a dishwasher and laundry facilities was great for a large family.  Sitting under the front porch was one of our favourite things and enjoying the beautiful views and the sounds of the waves and calmness of the water first thing in the morning.

reviews.author: Sarah K.
reviews.text: My family and I stayed for 3nights, was a beautiful place and kim was great!
